title: Reviewing
summary: Commenting on lines, suggesting changes and submitting a review.

stories.want: to comment on a line, suggest a change and submit a review
stories.soThat: a review doesn't wait until I'm at a desk

requirements.text: Tapping a line of a diff offers a comment or a suggested change on it.
Comments are added to a pending review, kept on the device until it is submitted, or posted right away.

A review's summary and its pending comments are kept on the device until the review is submitted: they survive leaving the screen and restarting the app. A comment being typed survives rotating and resizing the window.

history.text: What is typed into a comment survives rotating the device and leaving the screen.
history.reason: The first wording promised more than the app does: text typed for a comment that hasn't been added to the review is lost when the screen is left. That part is now `RV5`, not built yet.

requirements.text: A review is submitted as a comment, an approval or a request for changes.
Text typed for a comment that isn't added or posted yet survives leaving the screen.
